Review summary

Based on reviews, created with AI

Most reviewers were unhappy with their experience overall. People express concerns about several aspects of the service. Many consumers mention issues with the booking process, such as unexpected changes to flights and difficulties with seat upgrades. A significant number of reviewers also feel that the prices do not match the quality of the service provided, especially when compared to other airlines. Furthermore, a notable point of contention is the level of customer service, with reviewers reporting unhelpful or rude staff, mishandled luggage, and a general lack of support when issues arise. While opinions on the staff are mixed, there are recurring complaints about inattentiveness and disorganization among the crew.

Don't bother paying and booking seats!

10 1/2 months before flying,I asked Emirates and Qatar if I could book a bassinet for my grandaughter.
Qatar would not confirm we would definatley get one,Emirates on the other hand, said we would if the seat where the bassinets were used was available.
Quickly I booked all the seats with the bassinet for all our 4 flights.Manchester -BKK and return.
The Manchester segments out and in were fine.The Dubai BKK segments were NOT.
Emirates changed our flight and seats on our outbound Dubai to BKK flights while we were in transit.We arrived at the gate and showed the boarding passes given to us in Manchester.We were told we had missed our flight,but were actually at the gate of the moved flight.
After a very stressful 15 mins,we were told we could go through the boarding gate.Our seats had been moved!
But worse was to come for the flight home BKK-Dubai.
We got on the plane and our seats had been moved from the 3 with bassinet into the middle of the plane.
I complained to the air steward,who said she would check.I was 5 rows behind the seats I had booked and there was no one in them,with a reserved sign on the seats.
The stewardess then appeared in the other aisle and beckoned to a lady in a headscarf ,who was stood up waiting with 2 children and showed her to the seats I had booked!
I called to the stewardess and asked why this had just happened.A male steward then came,apologised and told me my seat had been moved,he didn't know why and to complain when I got home.
I made sure all the passengers around me knew how far in advance I had booked the bassinet and when my grandaughter was uncomfotable,crying,disturbing passengers,it was the airlines fault!
I can't be bothered complaining,it will get nowhere.
I wont be flying with Emirates again,as I'm not a local who gets preferencial treatment.

I had the unfortunate experience of…

I had the unfortunate experience of dealing with a company sponsored through Emirates called (DVPC - VFS)to handle my Dubai visa application, and I am absolutely appalled by the level of service I received. We submitted our application about 2-3 weeks in advance, but their response time was excruciatingly slow. Communication was practically nonexistent-existent causing unnecessary stress and confusion.

Despite our ongoing repeated attempts to reach out having to run out of time, the process only became more frustrating . We ended up having to change our flight due to the delays and lack of updates, resulting in extra costs and a lot of wasted time. What should have been a straightforward visa application turned into a complete nightmare, leaving us feeling disrespected and completely unsupported.

I would strongly advise anyone considering this service to look elsewhere. The lack of professionalism and poor handling of the entire situation made an already stressful process far worse. Save yourself the headache and expense—avoid this company at all costs! Very very poor, never flying with them my entire life and advising all my friends/ family to do the same.
